reviews.text: The front reception person is very knowledgeable and friendly.

Finally find my cat’s forever clinic. They are very professional and friendly. I even got a coffee when I arrived. I was planning to have my cat teeth cleaning but after doctor Grandy’s examination she said my cat didn’t need do it this year. Not like a lot other vet who only want you spend more money even it’s not necessary. So grateful I found this place for my cat

Since moving to Dallas I have prioritized identifying the right vet care for my two cats, as we had to leave my beloved Chicago based vet back home. Dr Gandy at Lonestar Feline Health Center and her team have more than exceeded my expectations. From the tender and compassionate feline focused care to the immediate follow ups and non-appointment guidance when things with one or the other cat hasn’t gone as planned, Dr Gandy and team are the only team in Dallas I would trust my cats with.

I’m on a recurring visit basis for both Elliott and Nova for the regular check ups, but when Elliott ran into a potential urinary issue at 5pm on a Tuesday, Dr. Gandy and team arranged for a 8 AM appointment on Wednesday and subsequently put my concerns to rest as they offered him full treatment and happy to report he is on the road to recovery!

I strongly recommend checking Lonestar out if you’re a cat dad (or mom) and want the best in specialized care for your feline friend(s)!

I’m so thankful for everyone at this office. I had an appointment for my sweet Natalie Wood for a normal checkup/ rabies shot visit. The night prior she had displayed odd symptoms. Took her in the next morning and the team was incredible. Natalie had swallowed something. Dr. Gandy was phenomenal. Performed Natalie’s surgery that afternoon. I’m just so thankful for everyone in this office. Thorough, knowledgeable, and kind. 10/10.

a great clinic! He’s a stubborn little guy and can be quite a handful—and, as a fair warning to everyone, he may bite! 😄 But this clinic makes him much calmer than a traditional vet office with barking dogs around.
Dr. Gandy is incredibly professional and efficient. She is truly a virtuoso when it comes to examining my kitty—she’s quick, gentle, and knows exactly what she’s doing. A blood draw, urine test, and exam, and we’re done!
I really appreciate how efficient and stress-free this clinic makes the experience for both me and my fur baby. Thank you, Dr. Gandy, for taking such great care of my boy and keeping him healthy! ❤️

We brought Lily, our seven-year-old spayed mama cat, to Dr. Gandy in April after struggling to diagnose and manage her hyperthyroidism. In early June, we discovered a malignant mammary tumor, and Dr. Gandy quickly got her scheduled for the surgery she needed. From the procedure through recovery, the care Lily received from Dr. Gandy and her entire team was exceptional — attentive, thorough, and reassuring every step of the way.

Lonestar Feline’s cats-only environment gives you a level of calm, focused veterinary care I honestly didn’t know was possible. We love this team, and we’ll never take our cats anywhere else!
My cat Honey and I love Dr. Gandy and all of her employees!

leaving this review far too late as I no longer live in Texas but Dr Gandy and her staff are the best! She was always very detailed and my Cleopatra was not stressed out during her appointments. Everyone here loves their job and will do the absolute most for your kitty, and they’re super responsive! I miss this clinic!

Okay, I totally get it now. This place is a GEM!! Not only is Dr. Gandy so informational and kind, but their staff such as Liz and Grace is so nice. My wife and I brought in our cat and right when we walked in you can tell a difference from their health center compared to others. My cat is timid so going into a veterinary office that doesn't have dogs barking really helped. If you're like me and research every detail and look into every review a place has before you go, let me tell you, I am so glad we found this place.

Thank you so much, Karla, for your 5-star review! We truly appreciate your support and are grateful that you chose us to care for your cat. It means a great deal to our team, and we look forward to seeing you again in the future!
Had a positive professional experience with everyone. Most importantly my cat Confetti was treated well and that makes me happy🙂🐈

It was our first time at this veterinary that serves just cat and we were very happy with the doctors’s comprehensive approach, the clarity and simplicity the way things were described to us about conditions and the treatment. We also loved the vibe and super friendliness at the clinic of all the staff. Definitely a place to bring your cats for a great care.

I love this place! They care deeply about my little midnight and always makes sure she feels comfortable. They are also very knowledgeable on literally everything feline so, that’s a plus! Amazing staff!
Everyone was very friendly and Dr. Gandy was very patient answering all my questions.

Truly the best vet we’ve ever been to. Dr Gandy and her team are exceptional - diagnosed and treated my baby and made the process as manageable as possible. Communication is excellent and her support team is efficient, timely,  kind, responsive, and helpful. Refills/meds are a breeze. Thank you for your care!

The entire staff and Dr Gandy are amazing! They genuinely care for your feline baby and take time to explain, have empathy and treat our fur babies very well. I always feel on very good hands with the Lonestar Feline staff. It’s a cute set up, which makes you feel very inviting.
Kind and professional service here.

Dr Gandy is very kind and very honest. I’ve taken my cat to other vets for peeing outside the litter box and they tried to push expensive medicines and diet plans. Dr Gandy recommended I switch his litter type and he hasn't had an accident since! The entire staff is super welcoming, patient, and knowledgable. I highly reccomend them.

I LOVE this feline veterinary clinic so much that I drive from the Rowlett/Rockwall area. Visits to the nearest animal vet used to be very stressful for myself and my cat. 🐈 I only went to them because they were close but I previously felt like a pot of gold rather than being treated like I had a furry family member. My cat would also meow and run around frantic and the staff was cold. I would also receive very generic advice. However, with compassionate advice from Doctor Gandy’s office, I was able to transport my cat Teddy with less stress. I love their system of communicating through chat and text and how we have an online profile to log into. Immediately when we arrived they comforted Teddy and he was so happy for the rest of his visit. I received the best advice and care and left with a solid action/care plan for my cat. I love that this office specializes in cats only and I learned so much more about caring for my cat than before! The notes of the visit were then messaged to me through their chat system and put into our online file for future review. I couldn’t be happier!! Worth the drive and I now have a vet for life!!

We just started bringing our little ones here.  This is a top notch place.  The staff is courteous, attentive, and knowledgeable.  I was very impressed with the facility and the service.

Our oldest is 10, and we found out for the first time that he actually doesn't have a chip like we thought (and have a number for, sigh).  The vet, Dr. Gandy, even had him x-rayed for free to confirm.  We were just always told and always thought that he had one.

It's just a great place, and you can tell that they really care.  Since it is cat only, you don't have to worry about the normal vet dog smell throwing your cats off which is a huge plus for us, and that's no offense to dog lovers, it's just a huge plus.

Update:  They still continue to be the best in the business.  We always get quick responses and great care.  You are doing your cat a disservice by not coming here.
Really appreciate the kindness and professionalism of the staff and Vet so amazing especially for someone who first time owning a cat. Highly recommend

I’ve been taking both of my cats to Lonestar for their somewhat differing issues. They’ve handled both wonderfully.  One is 4 years old with skin issues and the other is an 11 year old senior. They approached both from the POV of handling them the least invasive way possible up to more serious intervention while keeping me extremely informed at every step and being aware of my budget. They do their best not to stress the babes and to put me at ease, too.
Very friendly and attentive staff. Dr Gandy is wonderful and very thorough with my boys Wilbur and Ernest. Great location and well kept office.

We started bringing our cats to see Dr. Gandy and her team last year, and they are wonderful! One of our cats is a classic scaredy cat, and they are gentle and thorough but efficient with her exams so that she feels as comfortable as possible and can get back into her carrier ASAP. I am confident that my cats’ health is in good hands with Dr. Gandy and her team!
Staff is friendly, knowledgeable, helpful and professional. And I specially like the fact that they only specialize in cats.
Lonestar has friendly and knowledgeable staff, and they take great care of our two cats
Great quality care and customer service from front staff to the doctor! We love bringing FIFI here!

Dr. Gandy and all of her staff deserve more than 5 stars!! Not only are they knowledgeable, experienced, and well prepared at all times, but they love cats and show the MOST care for our fur babies! Everything they do is above and beyond! My husband and I would not trust anyone else with our babes. Lizbeth, Carisma, and all the others are so sweet kind and loving!  Especially because they are considerate of the financial obligations as well!  This vet is hands down the best we’ve ever been to and honestly will not take our pets anywhere else!

Dr. Gandy and her crew have been a godsend to our family. No barking dogs to scare our babies, and every single one of our kitties have been treated like family. The whole team remembers their names every time we go in- I can’t say enough positive things about our experience with this clinic. Dr. Gandy goes above and beyond, and I am so thankful we have a cat-only vet that cares so much. I wouldn’t trust anyone else with our cats care 🐾
Very compassionate and professional.
Always great service! Can get you an appointment in a pinch, fair prices, and always give Churu’s to my cat to ensure he’s relaxed. Highly recommend if you’re in the Dallas area!
Dr Gandy and her staff are so incredible! Kind people, great communication, and a clear love for cats. Highly recommend!
They’re caring kind, knowledgeable and I feel extremely comfortable taking my feline baby there for her care

Nice staff. I left without the problem resolved. I took my cat to another clinic before this one and thought I would get a second opinion from a cat specialist but left with the exact same results as the first one. My cat is still dripping diluted blood from which I still believe his mouth. We have 2 cats and separated them for half a day to make sure it wasn't the other cat and it isn't. So we are left without any treatment or detection of the problem. Also, we drove 1 1/2 hour to get there and before he could be seen they said he needs a rabie shot (almost $100) that's required but didn't let us know prior otherwise I wouldn't have went by bin desperate need of wanting to know what's wrong with my cat I did it. Just shy of $300 for office visit, anal glands expressed , sedation for the anal glands which never needed sedation for, and rabie shot. My cat left still bleeding literally paid for all of above that did not need, I told them he just had his glands expressed also. I wouldn't go there again. Back on the hunt for a different place. Like I said they are nice, this isn't personal, it's about my cat's health and hopefully some of this can be helpful to others.

Lonestar Feline is hands down the best cat-only veterinarian in Dallas!! The staff is so welcoming and patient with every kitty that comes through the doors, and Dr. Gandy is just as wonderful. We love their approach to preventative care as well as the entire thought-process behind making the office a safe and calming place for kitties. Would recommend them to anybody!

You can sure tell they love cats! The office staff was very friendly and informative. The Dr took her time. The office is beautiful. This is now my vet for my cat. Even though I live in Frisco, I’ll definitely drive to Dallas

I seriously can’t recommend this place enough! My cat, Cupcake, and I had a bad experience at another vet before coming here, so I was really anxious, but the Lonestar Feline team made me feel so comfortable. Cupcake is my entire world and best friend, and since she’s a senior, I was so relieved that she never had to leave my sight during the visit. They even gave her a warm towel to lie on! Dr. Gandy was patient, thorough, and took the time to answer all my questions. You can truly tell that everyone here cares deeply about cats. I was even sent home with some toys for Cupcake! I’m so thankful I found this clinic!!
Thank you so much for the 5-star rating! We truly appreciate you trusting us with your cat’s care.

The entire team at Lonestar is wonderful. Dr. Gandy goes above and beyond,  truly listens, cares, and takes the time to discuss things that we had concerns about after dealing with some health issues with our boy Percy. We are so thankful we found this facility. They have bird TV, towel warmers for purrito time, and only having cats in the facility helps with stress of the appointments. Also, very reasonable pricing they walk you through for procedures.

We love the online portal as well!

I had an amazing first-time experience with Lonestar! I discovered them through their outstanding reviews, and they absolutely lived up to the praise. From the moment I arrived, they made both me and my cat feel so welcome. The team went above and beyond, not only providing excellent care but also taking the time to educate me and answer every question I had.
Dr. Gandy and her team are nothing short of amazing! HIGHLY recommend this hospital for their compassion, care, and thoroughness. Best of the best right here!!
Thank you so much for the 5-star rating! We truly appreciate you trusting us with your cat’s care.

Dr. Gandy and her team are incredibly friendly and thorough. Our first appointment never felt rushed, and all of our questions were answered with care. Her feline-focused expertise made us feel very comfortable. Highly recommend!

So happy that I found this place! Everyone who works here is amazing and they truly care about kitties! I love the way they treat my cat Matcha, and the way I’m treated as well! All of my questions are always answered thoroughly and without judgement. Love this place so much!!!
Thank you so much for the 5-star rating! We truly appreciate you trusting us with your cat’s care.

The best vet to take your cats to! My older cat has stage 3 kidney disease and I switched over to Lonestar Feline where they did everything they could to help me get him back to as healthy as he can be. All of their staff is very friendly and prices are very reasonable. Could not recommend them enough.
The most caring and helpful team I could have asked for, and VERY affordable.

Thank you so much for the 5-star review, Victor! We truly appreciate your support and are so glad to know you had a great experience with us. Please don’t hesitate to reach out if there’s ever anything we can do for you or your cat!
Everyone I talked to was very nice, and they were very kind to my cat. The clinic was clean and everyone answered questions and wanted to make sure my cat and I were well taken care of.
So glad I found this vet clinic! They are really thorough and so attentive. Atmosphere is really chill which is great for cats. Highly recommend.
Great service. Very kind team!

Alfi aka (fifi)  and I had an amazing experience here!
My sweet girl was a friendly stray cat and she needed her first vaccines and exam. I could not have chosen a better place! Staff and Dr Gandy were super sweet, gentle and very understanding of my baby being shy and worked with her very well! If you’re looking for something to exceed expectations this is the place to be 😍 100% Trust

My cats are our only children, and I have some high maintenance ones with health issues. We decided we needed to find a place that focused on cats and I can’t explain how calm I felt when I left. The office is peaceful, staff and Dr Grady were all so kind. When you are stressed about your babies, that is exactly what you need. Thank you so much.
Thank you so much for the 5 stars! We truly appreciate your support and look forward to seeing you again!

Such a great experience! From the warmed towels to the complimentary nail trim with exams, Lonestar Feline provides so much more than your average vet.

This is the first vet who has given me a diet plan for my cat rather then just shrugging their shoulders at her weight. I really appreciate it and highly recommend them ❤️

Dr. Gandy and her team always take great care of my pets, and I trust her fully. It is worth it to know my “kids” are in great and safe hands. I have one who is more on the aggressive side with the vet and the other is more scared and she handles them perfectly, thoughtfully, and I won’t take them anywhere else. Thank you!

My cats and I adore Dr. Gandy and her amazing team!  And it really does feel like we are part of a team.  Dr. Gandy does not just go down a checklist...she truly puts thought into each situation and explains her thought process, pros and cons, and next steps very clearly.  She is patient with questions and her team responds quickly every single time I've reached out.  I really appreciate how she factors in lifestyle and finance as well to come up with realistic solutions to provide the very best care.  We feel so lucky to have Lonestar Feline in the neighborhood!  <3

April 2025 Update: Dr. Gandy and her team have been complete lifesavers. I brought my ragdoll kitten in after a few days of lethargy and not acting like his kitten self. Dr. Gandy immediately clocked that he had FIP. I was aware of what FIP was and that it was a fatal diagnosis, but Dr. Gandy was up to date on new treatment options that are not widely known. During the first rough days, Dr. Gandy and the team went above and beyond to check in on Pierre. After 3 months of medication, blood draws and visits, my little guy is cured. There are still several vets that don’t know they can treat FIP and euthanize or they are hesitant to start the treatment. I have no doubt that Dr. Gandy’s knowledge and quick action saved my cat’s life and I will forever be grateful for her. I live close to an hour away from the practice and will continue to make the drive out because of how much I trust them. ❤️

After finding a cat only vet in my previous state, I now solely look for cat specific vet practices. Lone star was great and attentive to my cat. We had to keep her there overnight and normally that freaks me out but I had great trust in the practice and they provided me updates. There was a true feline emergency when I went to pick her up so it was a little rushed but I honestly appreciate knowing their focus was on saving that kitty. That is what I would have wanted for my own cat. Pricing was reasonable and they walk through everything with you so you understand and they are up front about what is a necessary vs nice to have cost.

Dr. Gandy and staff definitely go above and beyond to care for your feline babies. I am very impressed by Dr. Gandy's background and experience and the office is beautiful - I got a full tour! I also appreciate the fact that only cats are seen here and that Dr Gandy owns and operates the practice versus a corporation.
Thank you Emily 😻 …

I wouldn't take my cat anywhere else...Dr. Gandy and her staff are wonderful. I especially love this is a cat only clinic so its a quiet and calm environment to bring your cat into when they're stress level is already high. Carisma and Lisbeth are exceptional, knowledgeable and empathetic and very good at calming down this nervous and anxious Cat Dad.

We took our sweet girl here all the way from Shreveport for extra advice and their expertise to see if there was anything we could do to save our girl. We love that they are a cat only vets office and we chose them based off of reviews. They gave us honest advice with her best interest in mind and didn’t force any procedure on her or us. We felt like we got piece of mind that we were doing the right thing by causing no more harm and to let Goldie live out the last few months of her life as comfortable as possible without extra pain and procedures. We got this card in the mail after notifying them of her passing. They go the extra mile and it is felt by her patients. Thank you Lonestar team. You touched our hearts and we appreciate you.

Mom of an anxious and skeptical cat... It is so refreshing to find a clinic that is patient and tender. I have been to several clinics that have not treated my cat properly which has caused me and her a lot of discomfort and has resulted in lack of trust.

The entire experience from start to finish was incredible. They allowed my cat to get comfortable in the exam room with treats and watching birds on the TV. From there, they evaluated her needs and made the call for sedation which would result in the most comfort for her.

I just cannot say enough good things about the clinic, the vet and employees. If you're a cat owner in the Dallas area then this is 100% the place for you.

I highly recommend this place! Everyone is so caring, knowledgeable, and attentive. Dr. Gandy and her team are absolutely incredible. I don't mind driving across the city at all knowing that my kitties are in
the best hands.
-Carolina A.
Dr. Gandy went above and beyond for my cat.  Ultimately, I made the decision to help my girl cross over the rainbow bridge, but when I get another cat, this will be the place I take him/her to.
Amazing staff and they really care for your cats!! They helped me bring my baby girl back from a very difficult situation and now she is as healthy as ever!! Love them so much!!!

Dr. Gandy and her staff are so kind and helpful. They went out of their way to be there for my 5 month old kitten, Alfie when he had a bad reaction to a vaccine. I’m grateful to have a vet that I can trust and am confident that they have the best intentions. Wouldn’t recommend any where else to take your kitty! Plus their office is very cute!
Thank you!

I am so happy to have found Lonestar Feline. I've got 2 cats, one outgoing and one very shy, and they have been so great with both of them, doing everything they can to make them comfortable at the vet. Everyone is so friendly and helpful with any questions or issues I've had. My only complaint is that I didn't find them sooner, since my shy guy had a not-great experience at his last vet. I highly recommend Lonestar to anybody looking for a good vet for their cat.

Lonestar is an adorable feline only clinic! Feels more like you’re walking into a spa than a vet. The staff is all super kind and Dr. Gandy is very thorough and detail oriented. Would highly recommend to any cat owners!
Dr. Gandy is the absolute best! We’ve considered switching to a vet closer to our home for our kitties but we just love her too much! Her staff is always so great too

They saved my cat's life performing the operation at their facility. Dr. Gandy is so wonderful and engaged at each appointment. Charisma and Ashley have had to deal with my spicy babies so much. Everyone is wonderful and I'm running out of character. Your cat will never feel like an afterthought here.

Dr Gandy and her staff were knowledgeable, thorough and very responsive in what had become an urgent situation for a recently rescued cat due to lack of care and bad advice regarding a parasite infection from my vet of many years. I will be taking both of my cats to Dr Gandy in future.

I have nothing but good things to say about Dr. Gandy and the staff at Lonestar Feline! They treat my kitties with such kindness and are very attentive. I know my boys are always in good hands with them. I love that the clinic is designed for cats, it makes going to the vet less stressful and a good experience. Will always recommend Lonestar Feline!

Lonestar feline has a comfortable atmosphere that is well-suited for cats, and the staff is very friendly and welcoming. They understand the needs and behavior of cats very well, and are so easy to get ahold of. They even provide coffee and wayer while you wait! Even while the office was closed due to winter weather, I was able to get in touch with Dr. Gandy when I was concerned my kitty may have had a medical emergency.

We love the staff and Dr Gandy at Lonestar Feline. It’s such a better experience bringing our cat to a feline specialist who has the experience and tact to address caring for our cat! Everyone is very helpful, kind, and informative. Prices are very reasonable and a dollar goes a lot further than at other vets.
Thank you so much for the kind review!

Dr. Gandy is an exceptional vet. Despite just landing in Dallas and the clinic being closed, she immediately saw my cat in an emergency. After two other vets couldn’t diagnose the issue, Dr. Gandy quickly identified cancer, providing clarity even though it was too late for a cure.
Highly recommended.

Very caring, knowledgable and attentive staff. Dr. Gandy and the Lonestar Feline team was very compassionate when my baby Luna passed suddenly and we definitely felt cared for when she was a patient here. Thank you for everything
Stephanie is amazing and caring, and her staff is very friendly.  Highly recommended!

Lonestar is amazing! The great thing about a private vet and not corporate vet is the treatment - first class care and service - a huge thank you to Dr. Gandy and the team for taking excellent care of my Sassy!

This place is amazing! My cat Peaches is my entire world and I trust very few people to take good care of her. She had to have minor dental surgery which of course sent me into panic mode. The team here kept me updated throughout surgery which eased my nerves so much. The team here is so kind, comforting, and they love your cats as if they are their own! I will recommend this vet to every cat owner I know from now on. Thank you for taking great care of my baby <33

Such a great place for cats and a wonderful team. My girl had a lump that needed to get checked out and they got me in same day. Nice calm/quiet place with no barking dogs to scare my kitty who was already on edge. Highly recommend!
Lonestar Feline is the only place I will take my cat. They are excellent at what they do. They are skilled and a pleasure to work with. Truly specialists!

I never leave reviews but I had to come on here to say I’ve never had such an amazing experience at a vet before!! Took my kitties Cosmo & Juno in for a check up as well as dental work. I was so nervous for my baby to get dental surgery but they walked me through the process and made me and my cats at ease. They looked out for the comfort and health of both Cosmo and Juno, while still making sure I was paying a reasonable price for everything which I truly appreciate. Both my kitties are happy and healthier now. All of the women who work here are so delightful, I would recommend this place to everyone with a cat! Thank you so much!
Thank you for the kind review!

I cannot recommend Dr. Gandy and this office enough. My cat was dying. She was literally dying – probably would not have made it another two months. She had diarrhea for over two years. Every single day. I had gone to the same vet for over 20 years, and I was desperate for help. We We had also seen an internist. Someone  recommended Dr. Gandy to me, and so I called  to set up an appointment. I explained to them how desperate that I was to help my girl, and asked if they could get me in quickly. They got me in the very same day. Within a month, Zoe was completely turned around. She was put on the correct medications and I changed  her diet.. I wanted to feed her raw, and I love the fact that Dr. Gandy does not try to talk patients out of feeding raw if that’s what they want to do. She actually listens. A lot of vets will tell you that it’s terrible for your animal and try to push prescription diet on you. She does not do that. What I also love about Dr. Gandy Is that she does not have cookie cutter treatments for each cat. My cat was treated as an individual for her individual symptoms. I did not feel like she was checking off boxes according to Zoe’s symptoms. She did research on her own time for my cat.
It’s been a year, and Zoe looks better than she has looked in years.
I have five cats. And I have moved all of my cats to her practice.
I cannot recommend her enough. I will forever be grateful to her.

The level of care and attention the staff here have for both the cats and the people is incredible. They truly do a better job with these cats than most of my doctors do with me!
The facility is clean and welcoming, they are thorough in their questions and explanations, and they do an amazing job helping owners with any anxieties they have. In my last visit, my cat had to be sedated for treatment and seeing her like that was very triggering for me. When I asked for reassurance that she was fine they not only reassured me, they also explained how the sedation was working, what that meant for my cat, and every little thing they were doing with her.
They are more expensive than some other vets but to me, the care they provide is well worth the price.
Compassionate and efficient
The vets and technicians are highly skilled and are incredibly kind and caring to my cat and me.
Thank you so much!

We just took our cat here and had a great experience! Everyone was very kind and informative of what would take place. It's also nice that it's only a cat vet because for cats like mine, dogs being around can be scary. I highly recommend this place for the care of your little fur baby!

I’ve hopped around cities since adopting my cats in 2020, and lonestar feline is by far the best care we have gotten! I don’t feel rushed, my cat’s problems feel heard, and they really look out for their customers emotionally and financially. Will only go to cat-only vets going forward!
To some people, a primary aspect of relocating is finding a new hairstylist.  Ours was finding a  Veterinary Team…and WOW, did we hit the jackpot! …

Great experience ! So happy they are specialized only on cats .The exam was really thorough and both the vet and assistants were super nice . Communication portal is fantastic.
Going back for dental work

Amazing clinic that has taken better care of my cats than any other in the area, at a far more reasonable price than most. They really care about cats at this clinic, and have educated me on some options for my older boy that I was not …
Lonestar was the best vet clinic I’ve ever been to, hands down. The staff was so friendly and offered so much good information to help me better care for my kitty, and they loved him too!
So happy to have found Lonestar Feline for our cats' care in Dallas! Dr. Gandy is wonderful and so is every member of her staff. They made us feel right at home immediately.

We've been going to Lonestar Feline for about 8 months now. We get such excellent help with Dr. Gandy and the entire staff. My cat, Cato, is a deaf 15 year old cat with lots of health problems and I know he is in the best hands!

The service is excellent
many purrs, much meows
